title: Pokemon Synchron Unite
core_mystery: Aurelis contains ancient Resonance Nodes that react to Pokemon emotions. Team Vesper believes linking every node will end conflict by eliminating unpredictable bonds; the heroes discover the network would instead erase individual will.

acts.name: First Signal
beats: Professor Elian detects an impossible resonance pulse near Lunaris.
The three rivals leave on different missions.
Team Vesper steals a node fragment after Gym 2.

acts.name: Coastal Circuit
beats: Ports report synchronized wild Pokemon migrations.
The player discovers Vesper relay towers hidden among public infrastructure.
Cassian Veyr publicly presents Vesper as a humanitarian research group.

acts.name: Veil of Aurelis
beats: Ancient records reveal sixteen guardians once kept the Resonance Lattice separated.
Vesper captures three active nodes.
The eighth badge ends the first championship circuit but not the journey.

acts.name: Second Circuit
beats: A new league circuit opens after the crisis spreads north.
The player learns the node system predates modern Aurelis.
One rival temporarily cooperates with Vesper for personal reasons before rejecting its methods.

acts.name: Fractured Sky
beats: Weather and migration patterns destabilize across the region.
The four Vesper admins control separate relay sectors.
The protagonists reunite the rival group for a coordinated counterattack.

acts.name: Synchron Divide
beats: Cassian activates the partial Lattice.
Cities experience temporary forced synchronization events.
The final three leaders guard keys required to enter the original core beneath Celestara.

acts.name: Coroa Astral
beats: Team Vesper is confronted at the Resonance Core.
The player chooses Pokemon bonds freely rather than through forced synchronization.
After the crisis, the sixteen-badge League challenge culminates with the Council and Champion Seraphine.
